disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia (abbreviated SCHZ in the paper); DSM-IV diagnosis using SCID-I; UCLA clinical cohort; N=38 after QC exclusions (original N=50 before exclusions).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "patients suffering from SCHZ ( N =38, Mean age (SD) = 35.1 (8.8), M/F = 32/6)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All clinical patients are from the UCLA phenomics dataset (Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study), available at openneuro.org/datasets/ds000030.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "the UCLA phenomics dataset (ref. 120, available from https://openneuro.org/ datasets/ds000030/versions/1.0.0), was selected as it included healthy individuals as well as multiple psychiatric cohorts with deep clinical phenotyping"

age.detail: Mean and SD from main text Demographics section. Min/max for SCHZ group not reported separately; UCLA overall eligibility criterion was ages 21–50 (reported in supplementary).

sex.detail: M=32, F=6; N=38; M+F=38 consistent with total N. Percentages calculated from counts (32/38=84.2%, 6/38=15.8%).
